test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Impolite
solution:
The correct answer is **'courteous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Impolite** means not having or showing good manners.

 
 
• Example- It would have been **impolite **to refuse their offer.
 
 
 
• **Courteous **means to be polite, respectful, and considerate in manner.
 
 
• Example- She was **courteous** and obliging to all.
 
 
 
• It is clear that **'courteous'** is the opposite in meaning to **'impolite'. **So it is the most appropriate antonym for it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Superior **means higher in rank, status, or quality.

 
 
• Example- John was his **superior** in office.
 
 
 
• **Uncivil** means discourteous or impolite.
 
 
• Example- He has been short and **uncivil** with her.
 
 
 
• **Blunt** means to be straightforward in approach.
 
 
• Example- A **blunt** statement of fact was made.
